title: Microsoft’s Outlook email hit by new outage
slides: Why did Outlook go dark again?
Another outage hit Microsoft's email service
Users lost access during critical work hours
Check Microsoft's status page before relying on it
Your inbox isn't guaranteed—build a backup plan
thread_text:
1. Outlook went dark again

Microsoft's email service suffered another outage, leaving users without access during critical work hours. The timing couldn't have been worse.

2. Not just a glitch

This is the second major disruption to Outlook in recent months, raising questions about reliability of cloud-based email for businesses.

3. Productivity held hostage

When email goes down, workflows stall. Teams scramble to find alternatives while clients wait for responses that never arrive.

4. Check before you trust

Microsoft's status page is your first stop during an outage. But don't expect real-time clarity—updates often lag behind the actual disruption.

5. Build your backup plan

Don't let your inbox be a single point of failure. Set up an alternative communication channel today—even a simple forwarding rule could save your workday.
